notes: Audit of public behavior for Formatter 3.0.0 (opt-in phones, built-in engine, numeralDecimalPadding, Intl subpath). Internal pipeline helpers (formatValue, getValueForFormatting, resolveRuntimeOptions) remain reachable for compatibility but are marked @internal and intentionally undocumented. This is content coverage, not proof of universal accessibility or production performance. CHANGELOG.md is the single history source.

themeReview.source: Maintainer requested lime green ("verde limón") in the 2026-11-05 audit and website request. Light #4d7c0f keeps text contrast on white; dark #a3e635.

starlightMigration.redirects: site-tools/assemble.mjs keeps the old root URLs (getting-started, guides/*, reference/*) as noindex redirects to /docs/.
